notes: Large-source-unit 7 retained: בַּל + לְ + עוֹלָם → 'never' is rule 35's named fusion, and the one word carries the negation, the temporal noun and the extent relation the לְ states; no morpheme owns a separate part of it.
'As for' is read as the connective the ASV wrote for the topic-shifting waw of וַאֲנִי (rule 14, open list); the competing reading leaves it added under rule 16 with the waw unrepresented.
